title: fix(app-shell): the bell header breakdown names its unit, unread topics
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgDFH4S5pR1C8YvYCWWsZfXx)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：铃铛弹层顶部明细的第一项从「N 条通知」改成「N 个未读主题」（十个语言包同键改文案），数字算法不变。
- 为什么改：同一主题 3 条未读 + 3 个待审批时，顶部写「1 条通知」，下面唯一的合并行写「×3 · 3 条未读」，读者分不清等着的是一件事还是三件。现在顶部说「1 个未读主题」，正是那一行。
- 风险与回滚：只动文案和测试；没有新 i18n 键、没有新导出，徽标算术（#7233）不变。回滚 revert 本 PR 即可。
- 先看：`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`（badgeNotifications 三行）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/InboxPopover.oneStory-27704.test.tsx`、`InboxPopover.tsx` 默认文案一行。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/InboxPopover.oneStory-27704.test.tsx`，预期 2 个测试通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #27704

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- `notifications.badgeNotifications` (the first addend of the bell header breakdown) now names its unit in all ten packs: en "1 unread topic / 3 unread topics", zh "N 个未读主题", and the matching wording in de/es/fr/pt/ru/ja/ko/ar. Same key, same plural family (every slot keeps `{{count}}`, as `inboxBadgeBreakdown-i18n-7233.test.ts` pins).
- `InboxPopover.tsx`: the `defaultValue` follows the new copy; the breakdown comment says why the unit is named.
- The badge arithmetic is untouched: `unreadTopics + pendingApprovalsCount`.
- The grouped row's other ask (expand to list its records) was measured first: `toggleGroup` already expands a coalesced row to one line per record. The new test pins that too; no code change was needed there.

## Tests

- New `InboxPopover.oneStory-27704.test.tsx` (real i18next + shipped `en` pack): 3 unread rows of one topic + 3 pending approvals read "4 total · 1 unread topic + 3 pending approvals", and the one row reads "×3 … 3 unread"; clicking the row lists D-1, D-2, D-3.
- Updated string pins: `AppHeader.inboxVariant.test.tsx` (×2), `InboxPopover.badgeBreakdown.test.tsx` (×2), `InboxPopover.badgePlural-13133.test.tsx` (×2). A grep of `ui/` (apps and packages) for the old strings and for `inbox-badge-breakdown-notifications` found no other pin.

## Acceptance notes

- Wording chose "topic", the unit the badge already counts (`groupNotifications` groups by `(topic, title)`), over counting the same unit in both places: counting messages in the header would change the #7233 badge arithmetic, which is ruled.
- ar uses one counter-style form ("مواضيع غير مقروءة: N") in every plural slot, as that pack already does for `groupUnread`.
